candidate: Graph-local prediction-residual features replace MoE-NP local pattern inputs in a small softmax member gate; output is a convex probability mixture.
equally_expressive_same_evidence_single: A joint single stacker receives the complete prediction/context bank and permits the same softmax/multiplication primitives, hence can represent the candidate exactly.
first_test: One full existing graph/bank; aggregation maps only; condition on labels reserved before backbone fitting and checkpoint selection. No new expert fits just to make this memo executable.
independent_ensemble_comparison: Apply identical fusion-fit/selection opportunities to a competent independently acquired bank; backbone acquisition cost remains charged.

paper_conclusions.takeaway: Parameter-free feature propagation bank plus node-specific smoothing/recursive/JK attention and MLP. Label propagation and repeated pseudo-label/distillation stages are separate native ingredients; the proposed frozen residual stacker does not inherit them.
paper_conclusions.title: Graph Attention MLP with Reliable Label Utilization

paper_conclusions.takeaway: Meta-classifier estimates per-classifier competence using local accuracy/posteriors, output-profile matches and confidence; selected classifiers majority-vote. Separate base/meta-training/dynamic-selection reference roles are explicit. M*N meta-vectors are dependent, not new independent labels.
paper_conclusions.title: META-DES: A Dynamic Ensemble Selection Framework using Meta-Learning

paper_conclusions.takeaway: Ratio-binned scaling estimates same-class-neighbor ratio using predicted neighbor class probabilities and learns validation-set temperature by ratio bin. True neighbor labels occur only in explanatory analysis and are not deployment inputs.
paper_conclusions.title: On Calibration of Graph Neural Networks for Node Classification

paper_conclusions.takeaway: Post-hoc nodewise temperatures depend on transformed logits, relative confidence, neighbor logit similarity and distance to training nodes. Positive scalar temperatures preserve each node argmax; printed softplus plus learned bias requires a positivity implementation qualification. Native calibration/selection roles not silently transplanted.
paper_conclusions.title: What Makes Graph Neural Networks Miscalibrated?

paper_conclusions.takeaway: Random-walk local context, feature-based edge discriminator and degree form local patterns; averaged global pattern and local/global MLPs feed a softmax expert gate. Printed binary-logistic objective for a multiclass setting remains a source/runtime qualification; no benchmark or full-version equality is established.
paper_conclusions.title: Mixture of Experts for Node Classification

selected_VALID_reuse: Retrospective exploratory only; posthoc splitting/aggregator cross-fitting cannot undo checkpoint selection.
stop_rule: No complete-task gain over strongest cheap/unchanged-prior/logits-only controls stops the graph-residual explanation. Matching same-evidence single or independent bank narrows attribution; uncertain selected-development changes remain unconfirmed.
unchanged_nearest_operator_comparison: MoE-NP local/global pattern extractor and softmax expert aggregation on the same fixed bank/declared probability endpoint. This bank/endpoint adaptation is not a reproduction of published experiments.
